# Rotaract South Asia MDIO (RSAMDIO) — Canonical Reference Document

## 1. Overview and Purpose

Rotaract South Asia MDIO (RSAMDIO) is a regional Multi-District Information Organization recognized by Rotary International. It is formed by member districts across South Asia to:
1. Disseminate information across Rotaract districts and clubs.
2. Facilitate communication among Rotaract clubs and leaders across the region.
3. Support leadership learning and professional development.
4. Promote multidistrict service projects, programs, and international collaboration.

### Key Organizational Facts
- Organization Name: Rotaract South Asia MDIO
- Compact Brand: RSAMDIO
- Rotary Year: 2026–27
- Official Website: https://rsamdio.org
- Contact Email: rsamdio@gmail.com
- Geographic Scope: South Asia (Rotary International Zones 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, and 8)
- Member Nations: 8 (Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka)
- Member Districts: 45
- Total Member Clubs: 4,000+
- Total Rotaractors Represented: 100,000+
- Governance Structure: Guided by an Executive Board. In accordance with Rotary International MDIO policies, only the President is elected by member districts; other officers and council members are appointed. The MDIO serves member districts and clubs and does not govern them.

---

## 2. History & Rotary International Charter

- Date of RI Board Authorization: July 19, 2010
- Authorizing Official: Ed Futa, General Secretary, on behalf of the Rotary International Board of Directors
- Initial Founding Member Districts: District 3080, District 3150, District 3160, District 3190, District 3260, and District 3291
- Archival Milestone: RSAMDIO was formed to unify communication channels and promote regional collaboration across the rapidly expanding Rotaract networks in South Asia. Over more than a decade of continuity, the College of Presidents has preserved institutional memory and guided leadership transitions each Rotary Year.

## 4. Digital Ecosystem & Platforms

RSAMDIO develops and maintains a digital ecosystem designed to support Rotaract clubs and leaders across the region:

1. Rotaract Library (https://library.rsamdio.org)
   A curated open-access knowledge base containing official Rotary International documents, club administration templates, transition guidelines, brand identity kits, and learning modules for Rotaract leaders.

2. Club Invoice Calculator (https://dues.rsamdio.org)
   A dedicated financial planning tool that enables club treasurers and presidents to calculate their January Rotary International club dues accurately, incorporating pro-rata member calculations, local currency conversions, and applicable regional taxes.

3. Publications Hub (https://publications.rsamdio.org)
   The digital publishing and archiving platform for district newsletters, regional magazines, and the official RSAMDIO newsletter, RSA Chronicles.

4. Rotaract Club Finder (https://clubs.rsamdio.org)
   An interactive mapping application allowing youth, Rotarians, and prospective members to find, filter, and connect with community-based and university-based Rotaract clubs across South Asia.

5. NAVIGATE (https://navigate.rsamdio.org)
   Interactive step-by-step walkthroughs and visual onboarding guides covering MyRotary club administration, officer reporting, project showcases, and citation criteria.

6. Rotaract Certify (https://certify.rsamdio.org)
   A credentialing and certificate verification platform providing verifiable digital certificates and event participation credentials for regional conferences and training programs.

7. PULSE (https://pulse.rsamdio.org)
   A real-time virtual room platform facilitating interactive cross-district breakout sessions, live Q&A, and inter-district townhalls.

## 6. Official Programs and Initiatives

1. RSA Connect
   Cross-border twinning and inter-district club collaboration initiative connecting clubs across South Asia for joint community service projects and international fellowship.

2. RSA Chronicles
   Official publication capturing service impact stories, thought leadership, district highlights, and operational announcements across the region.

3. Regional Training Assemblies & Gatherings
   Annual gatherings including South Asia Rotaract conventions, incoming District Rotaract Representative (DRR) orientation meets, and district officer learning seminars.
